synthesizedFacts.fact: Post-birth control acne is caused by hormonal shifts as the body adjusts back to its natural levels after stopping hormonal birth control.
Acne can reappear after stopping birth control if it was initially used to treat acne.
Post-birth control acne can be treated with medications like topical retinoids, antibiotics, or spironolactone, as well as natural options like tea tree oil and stress reduction.
The contraceptive pill can mask natural hormonal fluctuations, which may lead to acne flare-ups once stopped.
